recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. Follow up in OO Incubator and FHIR Extension Pack to decide how to support request-performerOrder for SupplyRequest.requestedPerformer without breaking the IG build; revisit core only if SupplyRequest returns to the active core build.
issue_request: FHIR-26952 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to add SupplyRequest.requestedPerformer and link the standard request-performerOrder extension so multiple SupplyRequest performers can carry preferred order.
initial_application: Core PR #3808 / commit eaa86743db added SupplyRequest.requestedPerformer and an ElementDefinition extension pointing to http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/request-performerOrder in source/supplyrequest/structuredefinition-SupplyRequest.xml. Extension Pack PR #218 initially added SupplyRequest.requestedPerformer as an allowed extension context.
additional_context: FHIR-43453 supplied prerequisite SupplyRequest workflow-pattern alignment and was applied separately. Later core commit 3b38b80cf2 removed SupplyRequest from the active fhir.ini resource list and pointed core pages to the OO Incubator IG. Current OO Incubator source has requestedPerformer but comments out request-performerOrder with a TODO that the carryover extension usage was breaking the IG; current fhir-extensions master also comments out the SupplyRequest context via 2b046fd3bd.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The source file touched by the original core PR is now outside the active core build, and the current live-artifact linkage belongs to HL7/oo-incubator and/or HL7/fhir-extensions rather than this FHIR core checkout.
